q: Do your sneakers run true to size?
a: Most do. Rally Mid and Everyday Arc run half a size large and Ridge Form runs slightly small. Every product page has a fit note written from our returns data.

q: I am between sizes. Which should I order?
a: Order both. With our two sizes, one return promise, you keep the pair that fits and send the other back free with the prepaid label in the box.

q: Can I change or cancel an order?
a: Yes, until it leaves Marlowe. Orders placed before 2pm usually ship the same afternoon, so write to us as soon as you can.

q: Can I return shoes I have worn outside?
a: Yes. The 60-day wear test covers pairs worn outside, on runs and on the commute, as long as they are not damaged beyond normal wear.

q: How should I clean knit uppers?
a: Remove the laces and insole, then use cold water, a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Air dry away from direct heat.

q: How do I look after suede?
a: Brush off dry dirt with a suede brush, lift marks with a suede eraser, and use a water-repellent spray before the first wear.

q: Can they go in the washing machine?
a: Please do not. Heat weakens the adhesive that makes resoling possible. Hand washing takes ten minutes and keeps them resolable.
